text:
Someone offers you an "AI SEO" package on top of your normal SEO?

Read Google's page on its AI features first. It says there are no extra requirements to show up in AI Overviews or AI Mode.

So yes, SEO helps you show up on AI. Your normal SEO already does that job.

Physio in Subiaco asks: "Does SEO help me show up on AI?"

Yes.

Google's AI answers link to pages from its normal results. If Google can't find your page, its AI can't either.

Give each service its own page. "Sports massage Subiaco." Google and its AI can both find that.

Plumber in Midland leaves his SEO company after a year.

He finds out they set up his Google Business Profile in their account. His reviews sit with them.

Getting it back means asking nicely. (And waiting.)

Check you own your Google profile. Add your marketer as a manager.
